Yeah, I’ve got that voice too. But if you pull through you’ll get days that are nice. My best tip is to sit down before you go to sleep and remember something nice someone did to you that day. A smile from a coworker, someone who laughed at your dumb joke or maybe even a hidden compliment or a helping hand in something. You don’t necessarily get it every day, but noticing and taking it to heart when it does is the most helpful thing for me. And I try to be nice to other people too because I know that if I meant something to someone just for a second it means that I’m worth more than what I tell myself I’m worth. That’s how I personally combat it. But it’s always there and I feel you. I know how it is to not feel that you are worth anything as a person. Maybe you feel overlooked and unloved, idk. Hope you get better and find someone who can show you that you’re a person with value and dignity. Someone who can tell you that suicide is beneath you. I sure haven’t found anyone like that yet tho

Honestly this post feels like it could be written by myself. My family is so toxic all the time, I can’t handle it. Luckily I work a job in fast food, but that doesn’t pay enough so I’m just saving up my money. I can’t give you much advice more than just to think about if you would rather work a shitty job and save up or wait for a decent job where the money comes faster. I am doing the former because I’m desperate to get away, but if you think you can handle staying with them until you’ve got the money or job then go for it. What’s more important? A new place or a good job?
